turns.question: It's 10 November 2026. How many orders did we get last fiscal quarter, cancelled ones included?
turns.answer: Last fiscal quarter (fiscal Q3 of fiscal 2026, 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-31) we got 217 orders (Orders, cancelled included), though the data only reaches 2026-10-03, so October is incomplete. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
